question: What is the supreme vital power of that seed described as?
premises: That seed also has a supreme vital power.
This vital power consists of the five elements.
As an object of enjoyment it appears as food.
It consists of sound, touch, and taste.
inference: The supreme vital power of the seed manifests as elemental food endowed with sound, touch, and taste.
plain_english: That seed too has a supreme vital power made of the five elements. As something to be enjoyed it takes the form of food, consisting of sound, touch, and taste.
